baseline_decision.decision: Implement a high-quality improvement system to organize and manage mealtime feeding assistance
actions: Implement a high-quality improvement system to organize and manage mealtime feeding assistance so that staff provide more consistent assistance
Help improve meal intake and reduce unintentional weight loss among persons with dementia
baseline_decision.rationale: The patient is experiencing feeding and eating disorders (poor appetite, forgetting to eat or drink, chewing and swallowing problems). The patient is in a moderate-to-severe stage and requires assistance with eating and drinking in an institutional setting. The primary immediate management goal is to directly increase food and energy intake and improve nutritional outcomes. The patient requires hands-on assistance with eating and drinking. However, staff or caregiver handfeeding assistance is not available at mealtimes.
